nodes.name: HTTP Request: Encharge Upsert Person
nodes.notes: FIX: removed the 'tags' array from this call - it was redundant with, and could conflict with, the dedicated tag remove/add steps that already run afterward. This call now only sets the custom field. | HARDENING: added onError=continueRegularOutput (previously missing, so a failed call would have crashed the execution instead of reaching 'If: Upsert Successful?'). Added node-level retryOnFail (3 tries, 30s apart) so transient errors self-heal before the sheet-based failure counter below even sees them.

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Remove QC Tag (unconditional)
nodes.notes: REPLACES 'If: Previous Persona Exists?' + conditional single removal. Per review: trusting the Sheet log to know which tag exists in Encharge is fragile if the log ever drifts from reality. Unconditionally attempting removal of BOTH possible tags is stateless and self-correcting - a tag-doesn't-exist response is expected and harmless (onError continues regardless). | HARDENING: onError=continueRegularOutput so a 'tag not found' response never halts the workflow (matches the stateless design intent), plus node-level retry for genuine transient network/API errors.

nodes.notes: HARDENING: same onError + retry fix as the Upsert Person call above - this node also had no onError set, which would have crashed the run on failure instead of reaching 'If: Add Tag Successful?'.

parameters.subject: Persona sync workflow failed

nodes.name: Webhook: HubSpot Persona Change
nodes.notes: Target of the Private App Webhook Subscription watching Contact Property Changed on hs_persona. Method: POST (this was the earlier bug - was set to GET).

parameters.content:
**Webhook Trigger & Persona Validation**
This workflow is triggered whenever the HubSpot Contact Persona property changes.

The incoming webhook is acknowledged immediately, then the workflow filters for supported persona values (QC Manager and R&D). Any unexpected values are reported instead of being synchronized.

**Contact Retrieval & Sync Decision**
Retrieve the contact's current details directly from HubSpot and compare them with the last successfully synchronized persona stored in Google Sheets.

The workflow always trusts HubSpot as the source of truth and synchronizes only when the current persona differs from the last recorded value, preventing duplicate updates.

**Update Encharge Contact**
Update the contact record in Encharge by synchronizing the latest persona as a custom field.

This ensures Encharge stores the same persona currently assigned in HubSpot before any marketing tags are updated.

**Persona Tag Synchronization**
Keep Encharge persona tags synchronized with HubSpot.

The workflow first removes all possible persona tags to eliminate stale data, then applies the correct tag based on the contact's current persona. This stateless approach automatically corrects inconsistencies.

**Audit Logging**
Record every successful synchronization in the Google Sheets audit log.

The log stores the latest synchronized persona, timestamp, retry count, and synchronization status, providing a complete audit trail and enabling future idempotency checks.

**Failure Tracking & Alerting**
If any Encharge synchronization step fails, increment the retry counter, log the failure, and monitor repeated failures.

After multiple unsuccessful attempts, automatically notify the administrator with diagnostic information to allow rapid investigation.

**Workflow Error Monitoring**
Capture any unexpected workflow failures that are not handled elsewhere.

A notification containing the execution details is automatically emailed so unexpected issues can be investigated without affecting future webhook processing.

nodes.name: Code: Verify HubSpot Signature
nodes.notes: SECURITY (must fix before go-live): validates x-hubspot-signature-v3 so only genuine HubSpot requests can trigger persona syncs. Requires: (1) 'Raw Body' enabled on the webhook node [already set], (2) HUBSPOT_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable configured in n8n, (3) testing the exact requestUri reconstruction against your real webhook URL - HubSpot's v3 signature is sensitive to protocol/host/path exactness.

parameters.content:
**Webhook Signature Verification (NEW)**

Validates HubSpot's x-hubspot-signature-v3 header (HMAC-SHA256 using the app's Client Secret) before any persona event is trusted. Requests older than 5 minutes or with a bad signature are rejected and alerted on, never processed.

SETUP REQUIRED: set the HUBSPOT_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable in n8n, and confirm the reconstructed request URI matches exactly what HubSpot signs for your instance before relying on this in production.

**Production Hardening Notes**

• Encharge write calls now use node-level retryOnFail (3 tries, spaced out) so transient errors (429/5xx) self-heal before the sheet-based failure counter/alert below even engages.
• 'Last Synced Persona' in the audit log now only ever reflects a value that actually synced - a failed attempt is tracked separately as 'Target Persona' and never overwrites it.
• KNOWN LIMITATION: Google Sheets is not transactional. Two webhook events for the same contact arriving within moments of each other could both read the same 'previous' row before either writes back, causing a duplicate Encharge write. Load-test concurrent webhooks before go-live; move to a real datastore (Postgres/Airtable) if this is a realistic scenario for this client.
